newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan allows record September foreign-fund entry.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan allows record September foreign-fund entry.

text.p: Stock market regulators said on Wednesday approvals of new foreign-fund inflows in September surged 52 percent from August to US$4.3 billion, reflecting a growing overseas appetite for Taiwan equities.
"Foreign funds have shown keen interest to enter our market and we have accelerated our screening and approvals," a Securities and Exchange Commission official said by telephone.
In September, the commission handled 32 applications seeking to invest US$4.384 billion and approved inflows of US$4.305 billion, the official said. Both figures were monthly records.
